title: Two-agent upgrade gate
request: Build TWO agents. A 'parser' agent receives a version pair from the coordinator and classifies the change. A 'coordinator' agent (the entry agent users talk to) receives 'upgrade <package> from <a> to <b>', asks the parser agent, and replies '<package>: MAJOR upgrade' (or MINOR upgrade / PATCH upgrade / DOWNGRADE / NO CHANGE) together with a review card titled 'Approve upgrade?' with an Approve button (selection {"action":"approve","package":"<package>"}) and a Reject button (selection {"action":"reject","package":"<package>"}). On the approve selection reply 'Upgrade of <package> approved'; on reject reply 'Upgrade of <package> rejected'. MAJOR = first number increases; MINOR = same major, second increases; PATCH = same major.minor, third increases.
